_help: Global settings. siteName = website title shown in the header, browser tab and share previews (text in brackets is shown in the accent colour). artistName = how Nihira is named on the page. nav = main menu (one line per item; 'path' is relative to the site root, '' = home, always end folders with /). An item may have 'children' (a sub-menu: same fields; 'covers/#ghazals' opens one section of a page). Keep the main menu to about 8 items so it fits on one line. footerLinks = small links in the footer. social = icons in the footer and on Home; 'icon' must be one of: youtube, instagram, facebook, x, spotify, soundcloud, link. siteUrl = final public address (used for canonical/share links). theme.accent / theme.accentDark = optional accent colours (#RRGGBB) for light and dark mode; leave empty to keep the built-in colours. Images: run tools/localize_assets.py once to copy every external image into assets/img/. artistAlternateName = other name used in search-engine data (structured data). calendar.icsUrl = optional public iCal (.ics) address of a Google or Outlook calendar; its events are copied into the Events page every 6 hours (better: store it as the repository secret CALENDAR_ICS_URL, see README). calendar.publicUrl = optional link to that calendar's public web page. calendar.showSubscribe = show the 'Subscribe to all events' buttons on the Events page. After changing siteUrl or ogImage, the 'SEO files' workflow updates canonical links, share tags, sitemap and feed automatically.
